notes: Twine is Sasikanth Miriyampalli's Compose Multiplatform RSS reader, shipped on Google Play (dev.sasikanth.rss.reader) and the App Store, and one of the few third-party Compose apps whose visual design is the point of it — dynamic ambient theming taken from the feed's own artwork. Reading the checkout: :shared applies kotlin-multiplatform, com.android.library and the Compose plugins, and its 22 preview-bearing files live in shared/src/commonMain importing androidx.compose.ui.tooling.preview.Preview — the multiplatform alias, not the Android-only annotation. They therefore compile into the module's ANDROID variant and render on the Robolectric lane; :shared declares android and iOS targets and no jvm() one, so the desktop lane is not available to it and renderer stays android. jvmToolchain(21) matches the runner, so no javaVersion.
